title: vllm chart values
description: Helm silently ignores a values key it does not recognise, so a misspelling in a 300-line override file is not an error -- it is a setting that quietly does not apply. This schema exists to turn that class of failure into a failed render. The case it was written for: `failurThreshold` instead of `failureThreshold` under startupProbe. The chart passes probe blocks through with toYaml, the API server prunes the unknown field rather than rejecting it, the probe falls back to the Kubernetes default failureThreshold of 3, and a model with a 40-minute cold load gets killed after 45 seconds -- with no error anywhere. `additionalProperties: false` is therefore the point of this file, not decoration. Blocks the chart merely forwards to Kubernetes (resources, affinity, tolerations, env, volumes, securityContext) are deliberately left open: the API server owns those contracts, and restating them here would be a second source of truth that goes stale. The vendored cart subchart likewise owns its own values.

probe.description: A Kubernetes Probe, forwarded verbatim. Strict on purpose -- an unknown key here is the failure this whole file exists to catch.

intOrPercent.description: An IntOrString: a bare count, a "25%" string, or "" to mean unset.

distPort.description: Quoted in values.yaml; empty means inherit lws.distPort. A/B + size >= 2 only: the rendezvous port for --master-port inside this role's group. Colocate and size-1 roles never render --master-addr/--master-port, so it is a no-op there.

gpus.description: Quoted in values.yaml. Empty falls back to top-level model.gpus. 0/"0" means no GPU claim (a deliberate override, not a fallback).

nixl.description: NixlConnector parameters. The chart derives --kv-transfer-config from these (kv_role=kv_both), no role-name is needed -- prefill/decode is decided by which side the router pairs.

mooncake.description: MooncakeConnector parameters, consulted only when pd.transferBackend=mooncake. The chart writes them into kv_connector_extra_config on the engine's --kv-transfer-config. Chart values are camelCase; the wire JSON keys the connector actually reads are snake_case, and the connector does NOT do strict key validation -- a misspelled key is silently dropped and the engine falls back to its own default. Chart-to-connector key map: httpPort -> http_port (currently not read by MooncakeConnector at vllm 0.30; emitted so the JSON shape stays forward-compatible), protocol -> mooncake_protocol, deviceName -> device_name, numSenderWorkers -> num_workers.

httpPort.description: Wire key: http_port. NOT read by MooncakeConnector at vllm 0.30 (the connector picks it up from nowhere; only moriio_connector.py uses this key at that tag). Emitted so the kv_connector_extra_config body stays shape-compatible with the nixl path, and harmless because the connector silently drops unknown keys. Per-role defaults mirror pd.<role>.nixl.httpPort so values stay pairwise distinct across prefill/decode if a future connector release starts reading it.

protocol.description: Wire key: mooncake_protocol. Engine default when unset: rdma.

deviceName.description: Wire key: device_name. RDMA NIC the transfer engine binds to; empty string means auto-pick. Only meaningful when protocol=rdma.

numSenderWorkers.description: Wire key: num_workers. Engine default when unset: 10. The chart passes 10 (matching the engine) so user-set 10 and unset-10 produce the same wire JSON.

extraArgs.description: Appended after the top-level extraArgs for this role's engines; a repeated flag's last occurrence wins, so role flags override shared ones by construction.

affinityReplace.description: Full REPLACEMENT of the top-level affinity for this role's pods when defined -- two affinities never merge. null means inherit.

schedulerName.description: Full replacement of the top-level schedulerName for this role's pods (A/B only; colocate never renders a role schedulerName).

global.description: Helm's reserved key for values shared with subcharts. Left open.

serviceId.description: The id this service is known by outside the cluster's object graph -- the one string the decision server, the SLO operator and the route all index it under. Not a Kubernetes name, and never looked up from an object. Empty means vllm.fullname. Supplies the default for scaler.customProvider.serviceId, sloRequirement.serviceId, sloRequirement.name, modelRoute.slo.name and modelRoute.monitor.model, each of which can still be set on its own.

workerTerminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Empty or null means "same as the leader's"; 0 is a real value (no grace).

transferBackend.description: Which kv_connector gets written into --kv-transfer-config. nixl = NixlConnector (peer bootstrap through vLLM's built-in nixl handshake); mooncake = MooncakeConnector (per-request p2p through the engine's own uvicorn responder, no region table). The mooncake path exists because NixlConnector's kv-region assertion breaks whenever the model's KV grouping doesn't pad per-layer and pipeline_parallel_size > 1; mooncake has no region table and so doesn't trip that assert.

rolloutStrategy.description: pd-ds DS-role rolling strategy override. LWS-shape (rollingUpdateConfiguration), the same field shape the lws block uses. Unset renders the chart's atomic default: maxSurge 0, maxUnavailable = role replicas.

colocateStrategy.description: pd-colocate Deployment strategy override. Deployment-shape (rollingUpdate), matching the top-level strategy field the chart forwards elsewhere. Unset renders the chart's atomic default: maxSurge 0, maxUnavailable = replicaCount.

backend.description: Which --kv-connector value the router sets, and whether the trailing mooncake bootstrap port is appended to each --prefill URL. Empty (default) means follow pd.transferBackend. Set explicitly only to deliberately mix engine and router connectors (e.g. an experimental engine backend that uses the nixl router pairing) -- the chart owner takes responsibility for the combination.

localKVOffload.description: Local KV offload ('L2'): spill KV from GPU to a co-deployed store on the engine node's RAM. ORTHOGONAL to pd: with pd.enabled=false the engine renders plain MooncakeStoreConnector as its single --kv-transfer-config; with pd.enabled=true the chart wraps [chart-derived PD connector, MooncakeStoreConnector] inside ONE MultiConnector flag. Also renders <fullname>-mc-store-config ConfigMap (mounted at /etc/mooncake on every engine pod -- pd role leaders AND workers, LWS pods, or the single-pod engine), renders <fullname>-mc-master Deployment+Service, and sets MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH=/etc/mooncake/store.json in the engine env. Disable to render without offload (pd or not).

backend.description: Only 'mooncakeStore' exists today. When a second backend lands (e.g. lmCache) it gets its own sibling block keyed off this enum.

mooncakeStore.description: store.json delivery config. mode/metadata_server/protocol/device_name are hard-coded (architecture-level, not user-tunable); the master_server_address is always the release's own -mc-master Service. The values below are the only ones the operator should need to tune (sizing).

globalSegmentSize.description: Wire key: global_segment_size. Per-engine spill budget (total across GPUs on that engine's node). Reference: 100GB for 8-GPU TP8 + PP2 + 1M ctx. Keep sum > (model's per-node KV + slop) and stay under shm.sizeLimit.

localBufferSize.description: Wire key: local_buffer_size. Per-engine RDMA registration buffer. Reference: 4GB with the same shape.

enableOffload.description: Wire key: enable_offload. Deeper spill from RAM to disk. Off by default (the reference shape).

imageOverride.description: Empty (default) uses the engine image. Override to run a different mooncake_master binary -- useful when staging a vendor-fixed master ahead of the engines, BUT version-skew is a hazard: the mooncake metaserver protocol has no cross-version handshake, so mixing master's tag against the engines' tag surfaces as silent 'store unavailable' with no wire-level diagnostic. Verify against the same-connector release notes before a partial bump; otherwise upgrade them together.

localPath.description: Empty means no model volume at all (no hostPath, no mount), which needs commandOverride -- vLLM has no --model then.

contextLength.description: Rendered as --max-model-len. Quoted in values.yaml, and empty means "let vLLM use the model's own". An integer is accepted too.

maxLen.description: Deprecated: the old name of contextLength. When set, it is used instead of contextLength.

gpus.description: Quoted in values.yaml. Empty or 0 omits nvidia.com/gpu from the pod entirely rather than requesting zero of it.

extraArgs.description: Appended verbatim to the engine command line. Entries are toString'd, so `- 2` and `- "2"` both work. Rejected under commandOverride, which leaves no command line to append to.

promptTokensDetails.description: Emit --enable-prompt-tokens-details. vLLM fills usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens only when it is on, and the gateway's request log reads that field, so turning it off removes cached-token accounting from the whole chain. Set false only for an engine image whose argparse does not know the flag.

commandOverride.description: Replaces the vLLM command line. null (the default) leaves it to the chart; defined -- including [] -- takes it over, and [] renders no command at all, i.e. the image's own ENTRYPOINT.

extraInitShell.description: Bash block spliced into the multi-node pod's command between `ulimit` and `exec vllm serve`. Anything exported here is visible when the chart's ${LWS_LEADER_ADDRESS}/${LWS_WORKER_INDEX} flags expand. No-op on single-pod exec form.

shutdownTimeout.description: vLLM's own --shutdown-timeout. 0 leaves the flag off entirely (older images, or to keep vLLM's default of killing in-flight requests on SIGTERM).

serviceId.description: spec.serviceId -- who the requirement is filed for. Empty means the top-level serviceId.

name.description: metadata.name of the CR. Empty means the top-level serviceId, which is also what modelRoute.slo.name defaults to, so the route's reference resolves to this object.

extraSpec.description: Free-form LLMSLORequirement spec fields, merged alongside serviceId. Open by design -- that schema belongs to the inference operator, not to this chart. serviceId is not among them: it comes from sloRequirement.serviceId, and a copy here is rejected at render time.

cart.description: The vendored CART subchart owns its own values; only the condition key is asserted here. Add charts/vllm/charts/cart/values.schema.json if that side needs the same protection.

continuationGateway.description: The vendored continuation-gateway subchart owns its own values; only the condition key is asserted here.

enabled.description: Reference an LLMSLORequirement at all. Off omits spec.slo and keeps the static ttft_limit_ms / tps_limit_tps.

name.description: metadata.name of the LLMSLORequirement whose thresholds replace the static ttft_limit_ms / tps_limit_tps. "ns/name" crosses namespaces. Empty means the top-level serviceId.

route.description: A URL path, so it takes the DOTTED spelling (fallback-modelforge-0.1), not the namespace spelling.

values.description: Free-form openresty route settings, keyed per route. Open by design -- the key set belongs to openresty's autoconfig, not to this chart. Values reach it as strings.

model.description: Monitor's ConfigMap is keyed per MODEL, not per route -- two releases sharing this value clobber each other's row. Empty means the top-level serviceId.
